evidence_excerpt: Development of GB268, a tri-specific antibody targeting PD-1/CTLA-4/VEGF, with enhanced anti-tumor efficacy and reduced toxicity in pre-clinical studies
reason: AACR peer-reviewed abstract explicitly names GB268 and states it is a tri-specific antibody targeting PD-1/CTLA-4/VEGF, satisfying identity and target under V2.3/V2.4.

evidence_excerpt: STING agonist for the treatment of relapsed/refractory acute myeloid leukemia and high-risk myelodysplastic syndrome: a first-in-clinic phase 1 study of GSK3745417
reason: Peer-reviewed publication explicitly identifies GSK3745417 as a STING agonist (STING/cGAS-STING pathway), a target distinct from PDCD1, with no PD-1 involvement in its own mechanism.

ClinicalTrials.gov records for ABP 206 (NCT06054555, NCT05907122) name OPDIVO/nivolumab as comparator but never state a target or mechanism, so they do not meet V2.2's gate for CT.gov admissibility; no rank 1-4 admissible source (Amgen official pipeline page or filing) explicitly naming nivolumab as the reference product was found within the search budget.

ClinicalTrials.gov records (NCT06112808, NCT06640530) name BCD-263 alongside Opdivo as comparator but never state a target/mechanism, failing V2.2's CT.gov admissibility gate; no rank 1-4 official Biocad or regulatory source explicitly naming nivolumab as the reference product was found within the search budget.

Same product as BCD-263 above; no rank 1-4 admissible source explicitly naming nivolumab/OPDIVO as reference product was located, and CT.gov records do not state a target/mechanism, so V2.5 inheritance criteria are not met.

ClinicalTrials.gov records for ABO2109 (NCT07680582, NCT07583953, NCT07683832) describe it only as a personalized cancer vaccine given with toripalimab, without stating its own antigen/target design, so V2.2's CT.gov gate is not met; no rank 1-4 source stating ABO2109's own neoantigen design was found. Co-administration with toripalimab (a PD-1 drug) is explicitly insufficient under V2.5.

The ClinicalTrials.gov record for GC101 TIL (NCT05098197) describes autologous TIL expansion and infusion but states no molecular target or PDCD1-directed design for the product itself, so it does not meet V2.2's CT.gov admissibility gate; no rank 1-4 source was found describing GC101's design as PDCD1-directed.

entry: TIL, autologous tumor infiltrating lymphocytes; pembrolizumab (anti-PD-1 immunotherapy)
reason: This entry describes a generic TIL-plus-pembrolizumab combination rather than a single named product with an admissible identity source; the unmodified TIL component is not itself PDCD1-directed, and co-administration with pembrolizumab is explicitly insufficient to establish PDCD1_MATCH under V2.5, so no single-product PDCD1 determination can be made.

evidence_excerpt: EVM14 Injection is a preservative-free, sterile mRNA-lipid nanoparticle (mRNA-LNP) cancer vaccine formulated with mRNA encoding 5 tumor-associated antigens
reason: Everest Medicines' own official press release identifies EVM14 as an mRNA vaccine encoding tumor-associated antigens; the product's own design targets tumor antigens, not PDCD1, satisfying V2.5's NON_PDCD1 rule for constructs designed against a tumour antigen.

evidence_excerpt: a chimeric VSV in which the glycoprotein (G) of VSV is replaced with the glycoprotein of the lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus (LCMV)...selectively replicates within cancer cells causing direct oncolysis
reason: Peer-reviewed publication describes BI 1831169 (VSV-GP) as an oncolytic virus whose own design mechanism is interferon-dependent tumor-selective oncolysis, not a construct directed against PDCD1; combination with the anti-PD-1 antibody ezabenlimab in trials is co-administration, which V2.5 deems insufficient for PDCD1_MATCH.

Peer-reviewed studies (e.g. PMC9300825, PMC10232755) report BJIKT's effects on the tumor microenvironment and T-cell exhaustion when combined with anti-PD-1/PD-L1 agents in study populations, which V2.5 explicitly deems insufficient (observed effects on PD-1 in a study population, not a stated product-level PDCD1 mechanism of BJIKT itself); default is UNCERTAIN_V2.
